blind.description: A stylized, cartoon-style birch tree featuring a slender white trunk with horizontal bark striations and flaring root base. The crown consists of several distinct, rounded clumps of foliage with layered, scalloped leaf textures in shades of vibrant yellow-green and leaf green. The geometry is solid, smooth, and clean with hand-painted stylized textures, standing directly on its flaring roots without an auxiliary base plate.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as an irregular, bumpy cluster of rounded green leaf puffs resembling a head of broccoli or a leafy shrub, obscuring the trunk beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 20 to 23 feet tall), with a canopy width about 1.5 to 2 times the figure's height (around 9 to 11 feet wide).
